errors.wrong: Summary: Remember that \"less than\" and \"more than\" put the number on the left of the operation (with stray backslashes before the quotation marks).
errors.correct: "7 less than n" is n - 7 and "9 more than n" is n + 9: the number goes on the RIGHT, not the left (and for "more than" either order is equal).

edits.before: Give the unknown a letter first, then let the words choose the operation. Remember that \"less than\" and \"more than\" put the number on the left of the operation, and that \"times,\" \"product of,\" and \"twice\" write the number right next to the letter.
edits.after: Give the unknown a letter first, then let the words choose the operation. Remember that "less than" flips the order, so 7 less than n is n - 7, with the number on the right; with "more than," n + 9 and 9 + n are equal. "Times," "product of," and "twice" write the number right next to the letter.
